purpose: Make presentation invariance, rather than stricter auditing, the decisive runtime descent condition for KuuOS observability dependent origination.

core_law.semantic_map: one explicitly named invariant projection applied uniformly to every presentation
core_law.invariance_condition: related presentations have equal invariant values under the same projection
core_law.descent_condition: only invariant multi-presentation sectors receive a presentation-independent runtime descent witness
core_law.obstruction_condition: a related pair with unequal invariant values is an explicit presentation-descent obstruction

compatibility_boundary.compatibility_data_role: precondition/context for selecting related presentations; it does not replace invariant equality

descent_semantics.presentation_invariant_descent: Different presentations are semantically identified because their invariant projections agree.
descent_semantics.descent_held_for_missing_invariant: The relation is known but one or more invariant values are not yet observed.
descent_semantics.descent_denied_by_invariant_variance: Related presentations disagree on the chosen invariant.

next: derive or register domain-specific invariant projections for GitHub/CI and other MCP presentations, then carry only invariant quotient semantics into later descent layers
